tools.name: satismeter_get_project
tools.description: Get the SatisMeter project this key belongs to (id and name). Good first call to check the connection. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}.

tools.name: satismeter_list_surveys
tools.description: List every survey (campaign) in the project with its id, name, type (for example nps, csat or ces) and state (for example live or draft). Use the id with the other survey tools. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/campaigns.

tools.name: satismeter_get_survey
tools.description: Get one survey by id: its name, type and state. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: satismeter_list_responses
tools.description: List responses recorded in any survey of the project within a date window. Each response holds its answers, the survey id, and the respondent and device details, which can include personal data (name, email). Returns data and page.nextPageCursor. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/resp

tools.name: satismeter_list_survey_responses
tools.description: List responses recorded in one survey. Each response holds its answers, the respondent and device details, which can include personal data (name, email). Returns data and page.nextPageCursor. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/responses.

tools.name: satismeter_get_survey_statistics
tools.description: Get statistics for one survey over a window: displays, responses, response rate, and the answer counts per question and score. Use it for NPS, CSAT or CES reporting. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/statistics.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: satismeter_list_responses, satismeter_list_survey_responses · Public sink: satismeter_list_responses, satismeter_list_survey_responses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: satismeter_list_responses, satismeter_list_survey_responses · Public sink: satismeter_list_responses, satismeter_list_survey_responses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
